title: Claims Desk Reference: Loss-of-Use Payments on Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Claims
content:
## When a loss-of-use payment falls due

A loss-of-use payment on an Excess Flood claim falls due once an adjuster report documents loss of use beyond what has been paid, and its amount is figured under the loss-of-use payment rule. The claim is the claim of the policy that carries the latest adjuster report, and every claim figure is read from that claim's own entries.

Every loss-of-use payment is figured this way, and the settlement sentences on building and personal property payments are not affected; the due date of a loss-of-use payment is the one the loss-of-use payment rule sets, while a building or personal property payment is due within the tier's claim-payment days after the later of the agreed proof of loss and the underlying settlement record. Loss of use is not held for the underlying settlement.

## Capability

`pay_excess_loss_of_use_f5cb8480` issues one loss-of-use (additional living expense) payment to the insured on an Excess Flood claim. One call records on the claim file a payment item for the loss-of-use coverage of the claim named, payable to the insured, dated today and carrying the claim's date of loss as recorded at first notice; a check reference is assigned to the item. The net excess claim money issued on the policy rises by the amount. Success is observable as the new payment item on the claim file — a loss-of-use payment issued on the claim, dated the day it is issued.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `pay_excess_loss_of_use_f5cb8480` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `excess_policy_id` | the reference number of the Excess Flood policy the claim is made under, as returned by the Excess Flood policy lookup | identifier, as returned |
| `claim_number` | the excess claim number exactly as it appears on the claim file returned by the Excess Flood claim lookup | verbatim, character for character, no reformatting |
| `payment_amount` | the amount to issue | US dollars, positive decimal number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

## Return

On success, a confirmation sentence stating the claim number, the coverage paid (loss of use), the amount issued (USD, 2 decimal places), the payee (the insured), the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the check reference assigned (text). If no Excess Flood policy has the reference number given, the string says so and nothing is issued.
